name: Recess
known: Recess is led by co-directors in a shared-power model.

name: Smack Mellon
known: Reynosa was the founding executive director (Wikipedia;

name: Storefront for Art and Architecture
known: Directors: Kyong Park (executive director 1982 to 1998), Sarah Herda, Joseph Grima, Eva Franch i Gilabert (2010 to 2018) and José Esparza Chong Cuy (2018 to the present) (Wikipedia).
Esparza Chong Cuy signs as Executive Director and Chief Curator (year-end letter, December 2024).

name: Triple Canopy
known: Staff include director Molly Kleiman and editor Alexander Provan (Triple Canopy website).
The website directs tax-deductible online contributions to a membership page, and lists a Director's Circle of individual donors.

name: White Columns
known: It describes its focus as artists who have not yet received wider critical, curatorial or commercial attention (White Columns).
Matthew Higgs is Director and Chief Curator.
Erin Somerville is Deputy Director and Curator (White Columns).
Exhibitions and projects supporting artists who have not yet received broad critical, curatorial or commercial attention.

name: e-flux
known: Companies on the New York register: E-FLUX, INC. (business corporation, filed 6 January 1999, Vidokle chairman), E-FLUX PROJECTS (not-for-profit, 2006), E-FLUX REALTY, LLC (2015) and ART DOMAIN, LLC, which runs Bar Laika (2015) (NY Department of State).
Owned and directed by founder Anton Vidokle through E-FLUX, INC.

name: Slought
known: Levy was executive director and chief curator from 2002 to 2022 (Slought).
Levy was one of its co-curators (Slought).

name: Artpace San Antonio
known: Robert Storr, then senior curator at the Museum of Modern Art, chose the inaugural artists (Artpace site).
The International Artist-in-Residence programme invites nine artists a year, chosen by guest curators, to live and work in three furnished apartments.
Since 2001 the residencies have used a guest-curator format (Artpace site).

name: Galería de la Raza
known: Wikipedia names Rupert García, Peter Rodríguez and Ralph Maradiaga among the founders.
René Yañez became its first artistic director and Maradiaga its first administrative director (Wikipedia).

name: Fundación Ama Amoedo
known: Founder and president Amalia Amoedo is a philanthropist, patron and art collector who has supported artists and cultural institutions for more than twenty years.
Named for its founder.
Verónica Flom is director (Fundación Ama Amoedo).
Programmes: the FAARA residency, grants, FAARA Conecta, exhibition support, curatorial travel, regional connections and FAARA Sur (Fundación Ama Amoedo).
The site names the founder-president and staff but no board.

name: Espacio de Arte Contemporáneo (EAC)
known: The project began in 2008 on an initiative driven by the National Directorate of Culture of the Ministry of Education and Culture (Wikipedia).
Programmes: open calls for individual, collective and curatorial proposals, residencies, training and research, a public programme of talks, workshops and guided tours, and the LAB EAC.
The ministry owns the site and its National Directorate of Culture administers the EAC (Wikipedia).

name: Museo Nacional de Artes Visuales
known: Directors: Ángel Kalenberg 1969 to 2007, Enrique Aguerre 2010 to 2025, Roxana Fabius since 28 August 2025 (Ministry of Education and Culture).
Director Roxana Fabius since August 2025.

name: Bukhara Biennial
known: First edition, "Recipes for Broken Hearts", ran from 5 September to 23 November 2025, with artistic director Diana Campbell (stated by the space).
Commissioner Gayane Umerova chairs the ACDF (stated by the space) and the National Commission of Uzbekistan for UNESCO (ArtAsiaPacific).
Organised by the Uzbekistan Art and Culture Development Foundation, whose chair Gayane Umerova commissioned it.

name: State Museum of Arts of the Republic of Karakalpakstan (Savitsky Museum)
known: Established in 1966 at the initiative of Igor Savitsky, its first curator (Wikipedia).
The director is Gulbahar Izentaeva, appointed at the beginning of 2025 (The Art Newspaper's 2019 article called her director since 2017).
Gayane Umerova became ACDF executive director in 2020 (Wikipedia).
It names the director and a deputy for finance but no board.

name: State Museum of Arts of Uzbekistan
known: Wikipedia reports that in 2014 the chief curator Mirfayz Usmonov was caught selling artworks on the black market over 15 years and replacing them with copies.

Designboom gives it 40,038 square metres gross, with more than 8,500 square metres of exhibition halls, a library, conservation laboratories and a rooftop terrace, between the Abulkasym Madrasa, the Istiqlol Art Palace and the Alisher Navoi monument, with exhibition design by Atelier Brückner.
Gayane Umerova is its chairperson (ACDF website).
The museum and its renovation sponsor, the Art and Culture Development Foundation, publish no reports, accounts or funder list, and name only a chairperson.
